definition: The president leads the executive branch and directs federal departments and agencies as they carry out federal laws.
example: Directing federal agencies to organize disaster assistance.
caption: George Washington with his cabinet, depicted in an 1876 Currier & Ives lithograph.
rights: Public domain historical work / Library of Congress: no known restrictions on publication.

definition: The president leads the U.S. armed forces and directs military operations. Congress has the power to declare war and control military funding.
example: Directing a military operation to evacuate Americans overseas.
caption: Abraham Lincoln meets General George B. McClellan and Union officers at Antietam, 1862. Photograph by Alexander Gardner.
rights: Public domain historical work / Library of Congress: no known restrictions on publication.

definition: The president leads U.S. relations with other countries, working with foreign leaders and negotiating international agreements.
example: Negotiating an agreement with another country.
caption: Ronald Reagan and Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev sign the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty at the White House, 1987. Official White House photograph.
rights: Official U.S. government photograph; public domain.

definition: The president proposes policy goals and works to persuade Congress to pass laws that help achieve those goals.
example: Urging Congress to pass an education bill.
caption: Woodrow Wilson addresses Congress seeking authorization to use military force against Mexico, 1914. Bain News Service photograph.
rights: Public domain historical work / Library of Congress: no known restrictions on publication.

definition: The president promotes the goals of the president’s political party and helps its candidates win elections.
example: Campaigning for a candidate from the president’s party.
caption: Franklin D. Roosevelt attends a Democratic Party fundraising dinner with Eleanor Roosevelt and party chairman James Farley, 1937. Harris & Ewing photograph.
rights: Public domain historical work / Library of Congress: no known restrictions on publication.

definition: The president represents the United States at ceremonies, celebrations, and moments of national mourning.
example: Speaking at a memorial after a national tragedy.
caption: Barack Obama delivers the eulogy for Reverend Clementa Pinckney in Charleston, South Carolina, 2015. Official White House photograph by Lawrence Jackson.
rights: Official U.S. government photograph; public domain.
